farmers_markets: Sheldon Farmers Market (Mondays 4:30-6:30pm, June to September, Historical Train Depot, Sheldon)
notes: Wilson family farm near Paullina in northwest Iowa, run by four families (Dan and Lorna's children and grandchildren); Torray and Erin run an organic dairy and beef marketing, April raises the pigs and chickens. Read homepage, about, products, FAQs and contact pages (WebFetch summaries only, so recheck the verbatim). Verbatim is the beef section heading on the products page; the beef text says the cattle graze rotational pastures through the year and mentions no grain, and says the cattle are not certified though the land is certified organic. Lambs 'born on pasture and finished on pasture'; pork pasture-raised; chickens and turkeys free-range on forage after 2 weeks in the brooder; free-range eggs. No organic label added by hand. The organic dairy is mentioned but no dairy products are offered for sale, so no dairy species. FAQ: reserve quarter, half or whole beef or pork; customer gives cutting instructions to the locker (not named) and picks up there or arranges delivery to a farm delivery site. Contact page lists three phones (Erin 563-419-3142, April 612-499-0338, Lorna 712-299-9110); Lorna's local number used. No shipping mentioned.
